description: This file contains CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations specifically for managing test run data within a testing service. It interfaces with SQLAlchemy ORM models and schemas related to test runs, providing functions for retrieving, creating, and updating run records, as well as filtering by status, test file, or test case.

methods.name: Optional[Run] get_run(db: Session, run_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a single run by its unique ID.

methods.name: List[Run] get_runs(db: Session, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, status: Optional[RunStatus] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of run records, with optional filtering by status and pagination.

methods.name: Run create_run(db: Session, run: RunCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new run record with initial status QUEUED.

methods.name: Optional[Run] update_run_status( db: Session, run_id: int, status: RunStatus, error_message: Optional[str] = None, log_path: Optional[str] = None, output_path: Optional[str] = None, report_path: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Updates a run's status and related fields such as timestamps, error messages, and file paths.

methods.name: List[Run] get_runs_by_test_file(db: Session, test_file_id: int)
methods.description: Returns all runs associated with a specific test file.

methods.name: List[Run] get_runs_by_testcase(db: Session, testcase_id: int)
methods.description: Returns all runs associated with a specific test case.
